annotations.title: Upload a playable ad to TikTok

description: Upload a PLAYABLE ad (an interactive HTML game the advertiser already has) into a TikTok advertiser's Creative Library. Pass url: a zip with index.html and config.json ({"playable_orientation": 0|1|2}) at the top level. Hermoso checks it against TikTok's rules first (no MRAID, calls window.openAppStore(), loads TikTok's playable SDK, no other outside files, under 5 MB) and refuses a file TikTok would reject, then TikTok validates it and it is saved to the library. The reply carries playableUrl: pass it to create_tiktok_smart_ad as playableUrls. TikTok runs playables only in App Promotion Smart+ ads with a video, for advertisers it has allowlisted. Pass playableId instead of url to finish one TikTok was still checking. Free.

advertiserId.description: from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when one is shared

name.description: name in the Creative Library, 20 characters max (TikTok's limit)

playableId.description: finish an upload TikTok was still validating

url.description: public https link to the zip; upload_file turns a local file into one
